notes.title: a note on optimized learning
notes.content:
a note on optimized learning
- being more first principled can boost learning
- e.g. for stats dont be like ok so proportion CI, proportion significance test, 2 proportion ...
- instead, 2 different objectives:
- around what is p hat? how can we engineer a range so that we can be more safe with our claims?
- hypothesis testing (very well motivated)
- known quantities: estimated sigma p hat, p hat, p, etc → how to devise prob that we see something
- we want such an estimate to satisfy x, y, z
- this is kinda the higher math way of doing it (definitions, make propositions, prove everything, slowly build real intuition) and i kinda like it

this would have been much better for me and probably for a lot of people
#learningsuite #publishonwebsite

notes.title: too many bike close calls
notes.content:
too many bike close calls
- falling without helmet
- hitting the pole
- being in the rain and having cars etc all around me
- cars zooming by me on the road
- on sidewalks because dont want road and then a car came rushing out, i barely got out of that alive and only had a tiny tiny scratch that didnt hurt (but we touched)
and missed opps, held down by needing to find a place
- needing to find a spot for it when there isnt one
- like yesterday i got lucky but also wasted like 30m (it was educational though)
- trying to bike to places and showing up sweaty → bad or showing up late because biking is slow relative to other things

sol:
- plan routes with more intention; if route does not have safe bike routes, reconsider
- stick to more safe known routes if i want to not think (e.g. biking at stanford is chilling)

pos experience w/ using deep research!

notes.title: rejection & connection
notes.content:
asking out girls & looking for collaborators for projects is very similar (how happy something makes you if you got it is inversely proportional to how sad you would be if you didnt get it)
- there is a spectrum for “how happy x would make you” that is equal to max - “how sad you would be if you did not get x”
- thus they are negatively correlated
- both girls and collaborators give you a really good connection
- thus generally afraid of putting it out there
- getting rejected sucks and isnt just nothing (esp to state of mind)
- but is probs much less than i think
- can get over really easily
- thus reach out more :)

notes.title: reset options
notes.content:
meditate to figure out what kind of cooked

*anxious / sad / jealous / unconfident*
- go through the things that are making you feel that

*tired:*
- **sustained (10m+) exercise**
- breath work
- bathroom/wash hands
- sleep
- hang out (from ur knees) (bloodflow)
- **talk with active people**
- reflecting (just thinking about stuff and staring into space)
- reflecting (looking at past notes and seeing how i feel about them; adding to them)

*really itchy, hot, etc*
- shower
- go outside and breathe

*generally:*
- eat fruit
- blast music in ears
- look back at really old notes or just thoughts from a couple of days ago
